name: Bhagavad Gita 15.7
text:
ममैवांशो जीवलोके जीवभूतः सनातनः ।
मनःषष्ठानीन्द्रियाणि प्रकृतिस्थानि कर्षति ॥
meaning: An eternal part of me becomes the living being in the world of life, and draws to itself the mind and the five senses, which rest in nature.
purpose: The living being as an eternal part of the divine, navigating mind and senses.
supports: Contemplation; carrying one idea through the day.
when: Read slowly, once or a few times, and sit with it.
